curriculum.phase_a: prebought=random (phase-A generator armies, start in DEPLOY)

config.eval_policy: deterministic masked argmax over legal actions, canonical view, one episode per layout, no TTA (true score, never shaped)
config.selection: none: the evaluated model is the model at T (final.zip / final.pt); no best checkpoint; validation is monitoring only
config.shaping: on (SPEC 7.4 potential-based, row z, training envs only; evaluation and validation always the true score)
